def change_date_format(date_str):
    # Split the date string into its components
    parts = date_str.split('-')
    # Reorder the components to day-month-year format and join them with '-'
    new_date_str = '-'.join([parts[2], parts[1], parts[0]])
    return new_date_str

# Test the function with an example provided in the question.
assert change_date_format("2026-01-02") == '02-01-2026'
